author: customer_1
text: I cannot sign in to my Apple ID — keeps saying locked for security reasons. Need help ASAP @AppleSupport

author: AppleSupport
text: We're sorry you're locked out. Please visit iforgot.apple.com to reset your password and unlock your account. If two-factor codes aren't arriving, check a trusted device under appleid.apple.com. Let us know how it goes.

author: customer_2
text: I was charged twice for Apple Music this month. Pls refund the duplicate! On iOS 17.

author: AppleSupport
text: We're sorry about the duplicate charge. Review subscriptions in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions and request a refund at reportaproblem.apple.com. Reply with the last 4 of the charge date if you need us to look further.

author: customer_3
text: MacBook fan is extremely loud even when idle. Is this normal?

author: customer_3
text: Any update?

author: AppleSupport
text: Some fan noise under load is normal, but constant high RPM at idle can mean dust, background processes, or a hardware issue. Check Activity Monitor for CPU hogs; if idle and loud, book diagnostics.

author: customer_4
text: Should I install the iOS public beta on my only phone?

author: AppleSupport
text: Betas can be buggy — we recommend a secondary device and a fresh backup first. You can enroll via beta.apple.com and leave the beta later by installing the latest public release.

author: customer_5
text: Cant download apps from the App Store — spins forever. Device: iPhone 13.

author: AppleSupport
text: Check your payment method, switch to Wi-Fi, restart your device, and try again. If it persists, sign out of the App Store and back in under Media & Purchases.

author: customer_6
text: How do I download all my iCloud Drive files before canceling?

author: AppleSupport
text: On a Mac signed into iCloud, open iCloud Drive in Finder and copy files locally. On Windows use iCloud for Windows. Ensure downloads finish before canceling the plan.

author: customer_7
text: My iPhone got really slow. Is it throttling because of battery? Device: iPhone 14.

author: AppleSupport
text: iOS may manage performance for aging batteries. Check Settings > Battery > Battery Health & Charging. A battery replacement often restores performance if peak capacity is low.

author: customer_8
text: iPhone won't connect to Wi-Fi at home but other devices work fine.

author: customer_8
text: Tried that, still broken.

author: AppleSupport
text: Forget the network, restart the router and iPhone, then rejoin. If needed: Settings > General > Transfer or Reset iPhone > Reset > Reset Network Settings.

author: customer_9
text: Got a phishing email that looks like Apple asking for my password.

author: customer_9
text: Any update?

author: AppleSupport
text: Don't click or sign in via that email. Apple won't ask for your password by email. Forward suspicious messages to reportphishing@apple.com and change your password if you interacted.

author: customer_10
text: Where can I find screenshots on my Mac?

author: AppleSupport
text: By default they're saved to Desktop. Hold Control when capturing to copy to clipboard instead, or change the location via Screenshot app Options.

author: customer_11
text: Need help with something but not sure how to explain. DM?

author: customer_11
text: Still waiting on this…

author: AppleSupport
text: We can start here — tell us the product and what you expected vs what happened. For account-sensitive details, we'll move you to a secure channel.

author: customer_12
text: Someone changed my Apple ID password overnight. I think I've been hacked!!

author: AppleSupport
text: Please secure your account now: change the password from a trusted device if you can, review devices at appleid.apple.com, and sign out of unknown sessions. We're escalating this for priority security assistance.

author: customer_13
text: Unauthorized charge from the App Store for $49.99. I didn't buy anything!

author: AppleSupport
text: Please change your Apple ID password and review Family Sharing purchases. Request a refund via reportaproblem.apple.com and we're escalating billing disputes like this to a specialist.

author: customer_14
text: iPhone overheating and shutting down while charging. Scary.

author: AppleSupport
text: Remove any thick case while charging, try a different cable/adapter, and see if it happens only while charging. If it continues, run diagnostics at an Apple Store — we're flagging for hardware review.

author: customer_15
text: After updating to the latest iOS my apps keep crashing. On iOS 18.

author: AppleSupport
text: Sorry for the hassle. Update apps in the App Store, restart your iPhone, and free some storage. If a specific app crashes, reinstall it. Still broken? Share the app name and we'll dig in.

author: customer_16
text: App updates fail with 'unable to download' on iPad.

author: AppleSupport
text: Free some storage, pause other downloads, and retry on Wi-Fi. Resetting all settings can help as a last step (doesn't erase content).

author: customer_17
text: iCloud backup failed overnight again. Error says not enough storage. Please help.

author: customer_17
text: Thanks — that helped partially.

author: AppleSupport
text: Your plan may be full — manage storage or upgrade. You can also exclude large apps from the backup under iCloud Backup > [device].

author: customer_18
text: iPhone dies at 30% suddenly. Battery health shows 74%.

author: AppleSupport
text: At that health level, unexpected shutdowns are more common. Consider a battery service — checkcoverage.apple.com for pricing and AppleCare status.

author: customer_19
text: Bluetooth keeps dropping with my AirPods. On watchOS 10.

author: customer_19
text: Any update?

author: AppleSupport
text: Put AirPods in the case, reset them (button on back until light flashes), forget the device on iPhone, then re-pair. Also update iOS/firmware.

author: customer_20
text: My iPhone was stolen. Can you track it? Find My was on! On iPadOS 17.

author: customer_20
text: Still waiting on this…

author: AppleSupport
text: Mark as Lost in Find My (iCloud.com/find) immediately, change your Apple ID password, and report to local authorities. Activation Lock stays on with your Apple ID. Escalating for stolen-device guidance.

author: customer_21
text: How do I set up Focus modes so work chats don't buzz at night?

author: AppleSupport
text: Settings > Focus > add a Focus (e.g. Sleep/Work). Choose allowed people/apps and a schedule. You can also link it to Lock Screen filters.

author: customer_104
text: Tried that, still broken.

author: AppleSupport
text: Free some storage, pause other downloads, and retry on Wi-Fi. Resetting all settings can help as a last step (doesn't erase content).

author: customer_105
text: iCloud storage full — can't backup my iPhone. Options?

author: AppleSupport
text: Go to Settings > [your name] > iCloud > Manage Account Storage. Delete old backups and large Photos. Or upgrade iCloud+. Backups resume once enough space is free.

author: customer_106
text: iPhone dies at 30% suddenly. Battery health shows 74%. Please help.

author: AppleSupport
text: At that health level, unexpected shutdowns are more common. Consider a battery service — checkcoverage.apple.com for pricing and AppleCare status.

author: customer_107
text: iPhone won't connect to Wi-Fi at home but other devices work fine.

author: AppleSupport
text: Forget the network, restart the router and iPhone, then rejoin. If needed: Settings > General > Transfer or Reset iPhone > Reset > Reset Network Settings.

author: customer_108
text: My iPhone was stolen. Can you track it? Find My was on!

author: AppleSupport
text: Mark as Lost in Find My (iCloud.com/find) immediately, change your Apple ID password, and report to local authorities. Activation Lock stays on with your Apple ID. Escalating for stolen-device guidance.

author: customer_109
text: Where can I find screenshots on my Mac?

author: customer_109
text: Any update?

author: AppleSupport
text: By default they're saved to Desktop. Hold Control when capturing to copy to clipboard instead, or change the location via Screenshot app Options.

author: customer_110
text: My issue spans billing AND my phone won't turn on after a drop. Help.

author: customer_110
text: Still waiting on this…

author: AppleSupport
text: Multi-issue cases are best with a specialist. For power issues try a force restart; for billing use reportaproblem.apple.com. We're escalating the combined case.
